tools.name: NFRA Compliance Tools
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: A complete suite of tools for auditors to comply with NFRA rules: Audit Strategy Memorandum (locally hosted and free), Audit Documentation on cloud (paid).

tools.name: GSTR-2B Reconciliation Tool
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Match your Tally or Easy purchase register against the GST portal's GSTR-2B statement and get a color-coded ITC reconciliation report. Runs entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.

tools.name: e-Signer
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Draft resolutions and letters on your letterhead, place signatures and stamps anywhere on the page, and export to PDF. Multi-page documents are saved right in your browser — nothing leaves your device.

tools.name: Computation of Income
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Upload an ITR JSON (ITR-1 to ITR-6) and get a ready-to-print Computation of Income with all schedules, P&L, Balance Sheet and taxes paid — generated entirely in your browser.
